decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted AQQ/79-01/L1, AQQ/79-01/L2, AQQ/79-02a/L1, AQQ/79-02a/L2, AQQ/79-03a
Received 19th July 2011 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The proposed loft areas, hereby approved, shall be used for storage purposes only and shall not be used as habitable rooms.
description: Reconfiguration and extension to three existing flats at first floor level including a roof extension to no.82,  alteration to existing entrances, insertion of roof lights to the front elevation and removal of existing canopy to the front of no.82
